DOWN THE STREET AT EYE LEVEL, WIDE: camera at eye level with a wide view, the street broad in the foreground, the hero at mid-distance with room on either side, rooftops and sky above

FROM UNDER A NEAR OVERHANG: camera set beneath a near overhang, its edge a soft dark band across the top of the frame, the street open beyond and the hero at mid-distance
FROM UNDER A NEAR GATEWAY: camera set inside a tall gateway at the near end, the gateway's edges framing three sides, the street opening beyond and the hero at mid-distance
FROM UNDER A NEAR ARCADE: camera set under a near arcade, its piers making vertical frames down one side, the street open beyond them and the hero at mid-distance
